entities.summary: Lake George or Lake Katunguru is a lake in Uganda. It has a surface area of 250 square kilometres (97 mi2) and is a part of the African Great Lakes system, although it is not considered one of the Great Lakes. Like the other lakes in the region, it was renamed after a member of the British royal family, in this case, Prince George, later to become King George V. Lake George drains to the southwest into Lake Edward through the Kazinga Channel. Lake George is a lake in East Africa. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
